principles.statement: A monitoring tool that cannot observe (no privilege, no device) must report UNKNOWN with the reason, as a successful answer — never as a tool failure that the acting loop will treat as a finding every cycle.
principles.rationale: Found live 2026-10-29: local security-mcp ran unprivileged, firewall_status returned success:false every 15 minutes, the sensor tick mirrored it, SecurityFindingActor queued it, and the I-Loop reflected on its own echo. The EU unit (CAP_NET_ADMIN) returned real rules. Fix: success:true, inspectable:false, ruleset:null, plus unprivileged evidence (service states). inspectable:false means unknown, never 'no rules'.

heuristics.name: Capability-limited sensor
heuristics.description: When a probe is refused for permission/device reasons, classify the refusal at the source: permission/absence -> success:true + inspectable:false + reason + non-privileged evidence; genuine breakage (binary missing, crash) -> success:false.
heuristics.when_to_apply: Any read-only posture/sensor tool that feeds the sensor tick or an actor.

decision_rules.action: Do not queue an AMT candidate or finding for it; record it as data. Re-evaluate only when privilege/device state changes.
